description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing LXC containers, including network interface iteration, container configuration, and container administration within the Thunder project.

classes.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network interfaces of an LXC container.

classes.name: LXCContainer
classes.description: Represents an LXC container with methods to control and query its state.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config
classes.description: Container configuration class with nested ConfigItem class for key-value pairs.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config::ConfigItem
classes.description: Represents a key-value pair for container configuration.

classes.name: LXCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages creation and lifecycle of LXC containers.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the network interface iterator to the next interface.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous network interface.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Returns the current index of the iterator.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of network interfaces.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network interface.

methods.name: NumAddresses
methods.description: Returns the number of addresses for the current network interface.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Returns the address at a specified index for the current network interface.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the container type, which is LXC.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the container's identifier.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the container's network interfaces.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator with configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the container administrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance by name.
